text:
maria g: Heads up — planning a phased rollout of the new rate sheet next Tue. Need final decisions on grandfathering windows + partial refund rules. Two cohorts (legacy, modern), A/B exposure for the modern cohort, 10% canary. cc @kevin t @samir @jess l @accounting-bot

kevin t: Can you share the cohort mapping? also need a sample invoice diff for the refund flow.

samir: What's our rollback trigger? and which metrics should SRE/console watch?

jess l: Legal asked for exact copy of the customer-facing message + opt-out wording. I'll draft if we lock rules.

accounting-bot: There are 37 outstanding invoices dated 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07 that may be affected by retro credits. See /billing/invoice-list?range=2026-03-01_2026-03-07

maria g: Draft cohort mapping (high level):
- legacy: customers on ratecard v1 or with 'grandfather=true' tag
- modern: all others
- canary bucket: 10% random sample of modern, stratified by monthly spend band

maria g: Refund rule proposal: pro-rata credit for overlap days between old & new pricing, capped at the $ amount of the net increase for that invoice. No refunds for discounts or partner promos.

kevin t: Example invoice diff would help ops to script adjustments. I sketched a query to get affected line items:
```
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, line_item_id, amount, usage_date
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE usage_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-07'
AND price_plan = 'rate_v1';
```

kevin t: We need to tag customers for auto-crediting. Can ops add `pricing_migration_tag` on customer record?

eli: Yes, ops can add tag. We'll coordinate a short maintenance window for the script to run. Need the final tag list by EOD Fri.

samir: Rollback triggers (suggested):
- >5% increase in 7d churn for canary cohort relative to baseline
- >15% spike in support tickets mentioning "billing" or "unexpected charge" from the canary cohort
- Latency/availability regressions unrelated to billing: auto rollback if 95th token latency +50ms vs baseline

jess l: I'll loop in legal for the wording. Also want SLA note for Dedicated customers — are we keeping them on old pricing by default?

maria g: Dedicated customers: keep on current rate unless they opt into new price. We'll add a checkbox in the console rollout UI.

kevin t: Approvals checklist for finance:
- final price sheet uploaded to repo (PR + checksum)
- migration script in infra repo and tested on staging
- communication drafts approved by legal & comms
- taglist exported and ops runbook published
- finance sign-off on refund cap formula

maria g: I've uploaded a draft price sheet and the refund formula calc to the shared drive: https://redwood/drive/pricing/2026-q2-rollout.xlsm

accounting-bot: NOTE: Any retro credits will create negative adjustments on invoices. Please follow invoice automation runbook to ensure AR reconciliation: /runbooks/invoice-adjustments-v2

samir: For A/B gating: suggest we run A/B for 2 weeks with weekly checkpoint. Metric buckets: revenue delta, churn, support rate, NPS (sample). If pass -> ramp 25% -> 50% -> all. If fail -> freeze and rollback.

maria g: Ops/Finance decision needed by Fri EOD: grandfather window (suggested 90 days), refund cap (suggested cap = net increase on invoice), and initial canary size (suggested 10%).

jess l: I'll post draft customer message this afternoon. Quick ask: legal requires a short opt-out API for partners. Kevin, can PA create a temporary endpoint?

kevin t: Yes, can spin up a lightweight endpoint that toggles `pricing_opt_out` flag. Will need auth scope and 2-day TTL for safety.

eli: Ops will run a dry run on staging Sat 03:00 UTC and provide the results in this thread.

maria g: Thanks all — please add any blockers. If no objections by EOD Fri we'll lock the plan and start scheduling comms. :thumbsup:
